name: tarot-oracle-app
description: Multi-oracle divination app — client (React/Vite) + server (Express/TS). This root package only fans scripts out to both; each package installs and builds on its own.

scripts.lint: npm --prefix client run lint && npm --prefix server run lint
scripts.format: npm --prefix client run format && npm --prefix server run format
scripts.format:check: npm --prefix client run format:check && npm --prefix server run format:check
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run stylelint && npm run format:check
scripts.fix: npm --prefix client run lint:fix && npm --prefix server run lint:fix && npm --prefix client run stylelint:fix && npm run format
scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
